summary: Private network installs complete, and region problems are caught before anything is created.

new.title: Region check catches more problems up front
new.text: The region check now also works on a fresh install and tests with the same settings as the real install, so it no longer stops installs your policies allow.

fixes.title: Private network install creates its key
fixes.text: A private network install no longer stops when it creates its Key Vault key. The vault stays closed to the public internet.

fixes.title: Web sign-in step waits for Microsoft Entra
fixes.text: The web sign-in step now waits for the new app to appear in Microsoft Entra before it gives consent, instead of failing once.
